reason: I already have my supplement routine and I reorder it when it runs out, so I am not looking for another brand. A foil sachet a day also sounds like a lot of packaging to throw away.
objection: Thirty foil sachets a month is more packaging waste, and I already have a brand I reorder without thinking about it.
would_change_my_mind: Recyclable or minimal packaging, plus a reason it beats what I already take, such as a friend I trust switching to it.
